correctness.rationale: PASS: Every 32-state de Bruijn successor permutation is encoded by exactly 16 binary local switches t_x, since predecessor/successor balancing at each 4-bit suffix forces a bijection (0,x),(1,x) to (x,0),(x,1). The one-orbit condition enumerates all binary order-five cyclic words without rotation duplicates via their unique 00000 state. The greedy LPF matching definitions for overlapping and disjoint-source LZ77 are explicit and exhaustive over all earlier source positions, with end boundary truncation. A fresh independent implementation enumerated all 65,536 switch settings, selected exactly 2,048 cycles, all 32 roots, and recomputed both parsing counts directly; it reproduced all 24 nonzero joint cells, gap counts (8848,20732,20334,11878,3468,268,8) for gains 0..6, and eight per-cycle gain-range cells, total 65,536 roots. The supplied checker also provides independent Euler-tour and suffix-LCP checks, whose code was inspected. This is a complete finite census, not a sample; the theorem makes no claim for higher de Bruijn orders or other LZ conventions.
